behavior: Избегать тонких начертаний — они плохо читаются в мелком тексте

behavior: Обрезку текста при увеличенном шрифте сводить к минимуму

quote: Short, succinct text can help minimize truncation and wrapping, making text easier to read and scan.

quote: Multicolumn text can also be less readable at large sizes due to horizontal space constraints. Reduce the number of columns when the font size increases to avoid truncation and enhance readability.

quote: Avoid truncating text in scrollable regions unless people can open a separate view to read the rest of the content.
